\begin{quote}
\textbf{Asymmetric Patience 1:} Consider a three-period sequential (alternating-offer) bargaining model in which two players have to split a pie worth 1 (starting with player 1 making the offer). Now the players have different discount factors, \(\delta_1\) and \(\delta_2\).

\begin{enumerate}
\def\labelenumi{\alph{enumi}.}
\item
  Compute the outcome of the unique subgame-perfect equilibrium.
\item
  Show that when \(\delta_1 = \delta_2\) player 1 has an advantage.
\item
  What conditions on \(\delta_1\) and \(\delta_2\) give player 2 an advantage? Why?
\end{enumerate}
\end{quote}
